prompt_en: Create a photorealistic high-craft editorial centered on high-jewelry setting craft. Show an adult fictional woman whose general appearance follows the attached portrait: long center-parted dark wavy hair, brown eyes, a softly oval facial outline, natural brows, and precise concentration. At a compact jeweler's bench inside a pressurized deep-sea submersible laboratory, she places the final matched blue-green gemstone into an original tidal-navigation brooch beneath a binocular microscope. The stones form a deliberate graduated sequence matched by size and color; a graduated gemstone layout remains clear. Prongs visibly hold each stone beside a partial bezel or pavé contact. A platinum-toned metal gallery supports the stones, and the stones and metal share one original composition in spiral-wave geometry. Use a medium-close, slightly oblique frame that keeps her face, steady working hands, loupe, ordered tray, and magnified brooch work point readable together. Controlled specular highlights reveal every holding contact without obscuring structure, while soft bioluminescent ocean light and warm bench illumination separate gemstone facets, polished edges, brushed planes, and gallery depth.
